description: Your iCloud on your PC: Notes, Reminders, Calendar, Contacts, Drive and Photos in one app. Not affiliated with Apple.
notes: Your library and settings are kept in your user profile, outside the app folder, so they stay across updates. Update with: scoop update skykeep
##: The release's NSIS installer, unpacked by 7-Zip rather than run (the way Scoop Extras ships Tauri apps), so nothing is written outside Scoop's folder.
No persist: Skykeep keeps nothing in its own folder. Releases after 0.1.2 see Scoop's scoop-install.json beside skykeep.exe and leave updates to Scoop instead of offering their own installer.
